requested: execute one formal runtime audit for the v016 single-Reward privileged Oracle route

review.scope: global-test fidelity, ownership, lifecycle, and evidence boundary

source_edits.scope: local formal test identity/assertions only; no production behavior

report_write.scope: local plan, review, route evidence, and audit receipts

repository_discipline.rationale: The test depends one-way on existing production owners and adds no script, backend, phase, Reward, runner, or checkpoint behavior.

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: The rig orchestrates only; Hydra, G1 phase/Reward owners, MuJoCo, ReplayBuffer, learner, runner, and checkpoint gateway retain all decisions.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: Only build_runner, BackendAdapter, create_env, NpEnvState, ReplayBuffer, learner update, runner saver, strict load, and gateway interfaces are used.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: Test code imports production; production imports no test code and exposes no audit flag or alternate composition root.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: Reset and step expose phase-neutral observations, transition creates Reward, replay consumes it, updates execute once, and persistence crosses save/load/finalize.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: The existing formal-route program is reused unchanged under the v016 identity; no production file belongs to this audit unit.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Local CPU/MuJoCo integration remains separate from server collector/CUDA, convergence, policy quality, Planner-IDM readiness, and deployment.

dimensions.name: proof-route
dimensions.evidence: Every critical point has an observation identity witness, branch activation witness, Reward-carrier equality, update witness, persistence witness, and falsifier.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: Real env Actor/Critic observations and Reward enter replay under 98/303/29; the two phase slots are inspected at the final Actor carrier.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Production Critic and Actor updates execute once; Actor parameter delta is observed and no audit optimizer exists.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: Full-state strict round trip and exact 20+1 gateway finalization remain inside a temporary directory.

dimensions.name: repository-discipline
dimensions.evidence: Config-first, owner-layer, backend-isolation, cold-path persistence, and scripts-assembly rules are preserved.

residual_risks.description: The local rig cannot prove the server collector subprocess, CPU-pinned transfer, and CUDA learner lifecycle.
residual_risks.disposition: After local edges close, retain exactly one LIVE_REQUIRED fact and do not start training.
